problem: self-hosted file sync is slow, fragile and costly to run
why: people keep control of their own files without a server to babysit
outcomes: existing Nextcloud apps sync with no change
no file is ever lost or silently overwritten
a sync of many small files finishes quickly

measures.text: files lost or overwritten without a conflict copy

constraints: speaks the Nextcloud client protocols as built
runs on Cloud Run and Cloud Storage
